card.name: Punctuation inside academic citations
card.fires_on: Punctuation or spacing inside reference lists and citation lines, such as commas and periods after author initials, publishers, or page numbers. Also the gap before a posting date on paper-listing pages.

modes.label: Author initials and publisher commas
modes.description: Periods or commas after author initials or a publisher name in a reference entry.
modes.example: Vickers-Rich, P., Monaghan, J. M., Baird, R<<.>> F. and Rich, T. H

modes.label: Page and year numbers
modes.description: A comma or digit inside page ranges or years in a citation.

modes.label: Paper-listing page edges
modes.description: Spacing or punctuation just before a posted date or page footer on an article listing.

card.plain: It fires on the small punctuation marks inside reference lists, where authors, journals and pages are strung together.
